recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group wants an additional non-normative rendered example for choice/open-choice items; the current conformance source does not need a FHIR-17344 fix.
issue_request: FHIR-17344 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification STU3 Questionnaire change request asking that Questionnaire.item.repeats be clarified after implementer confusion about whether repeats=true supports common checkbox/check-all-that-apply or "any of these choices" questions. The accepted resolution was to explain both rendering scenarios and what is typical.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in the 2018 git-svn history near the Jira comment's SVN reference. Commit fccd01d1da946ae8d270f20c68e2b6407b3b6dec, git-svn r14686, updated source/questionnaire/questionnaire-spreadsheet.xml to explain that a repeated question may be rendered by repeating the question text or by allowing entry/selection of multiple answers, and that either rendering produces one QuestionnaireResponse question item with multiple answers.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini and the old spreadsheet source was later refactored into source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml. Later Published/Applied issues FHIR-33335 and FHIR-55973 refined the same element by making the question-vs-group QuestionnaireResponse representation explicit and requiring repeated question answers to be distinct. The originating Zulip thread confirms the practical use case was check-all-that-apply and that most cases render multiple answers rather than repeated question text. Confluence searches found no conflicting meeting evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Questionnaire.item.repeats definition and comment already say that repeated questions produce multiple distinct answers in one item, repeated groups produce multiple items, and renderers may either repeat the question text or simply allow multiple answer entry/selection.
